newJobs.descriptionText: CAE Project Engineer This is a hybrid position and requires onsite work at our Towson, MD Design Center 3 days per week. Towson, MD, United States Come build something that matters. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of more than 50,000 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced CAE Project Engineer to join our Towson CAE team. In this individual contributor role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to utilize advanced simulation tools for analyzing and optimizing the durability and performance of our power tool products. Your expertise in CAE simulation technologies will be crucial in driving product development and ensuring high-quality outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Utilize CAE simulation technologies to support product development. Translate product design requirements into simulation project specifications, employing appropriate simulation techniques to ensure quality and performance. Conduct structural analysis using FEA tools in areas including linear static, non-linear static, transient dynamic, noise and vibration, material damage, fatigue life prediction, fluid structure interaction, design optimization, co-simulation, and multi-physics simulation. Verify simulation results with theoretical methods and test data. Analyze simulation results to inform sound design and business decisions in complex technical situations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve optimal product development solutions. Study the fundamental physics behind products using CAE and other analytical tools. Develop advanced methods and processes to enhance simulation capability and efficiency. Manage and deliver multiple projects with increasing technical complexity. Work effectively in a fast-paced team environment, communicating efficiently with cross-functional teams. Qualifications: Master’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Material Science, Physics, or a related field. 6+ years of hands-on experience in FEA modeling within the consumer products industry. Proficiency in major FEA tools (e.g., ANSYS, LS-DYNA, ABAQUS, Hypermesh, or equivalent). Strong knowledge of FEA theory, material failure criteria, solid mechanics, and fracture mechanics. Experience in one or more of the following areas: advanced dynamic impacts, advanced material modeling, fatigue calculation, vibration modeling, wear phenomena modeling, programming, and design optimization. Experience with 3D CAD & PLM systems. Ability to verify simulation results using sound engineering principles. Understanding of mass production manufacturing methods, such as die casting, plastic injection molding, and forging. Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment. Ability to manage multiple projects and flexible to adjust project priorities based on current business needs. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail. Ability to generate and evaluate creative ideas. Excellent technical documentation skills and strong written and verbal communication abilities. Preferred Skillsets: 10+ years of hands-on experience in applying FEA within the consumer products industry. Experience in FEA modeling specifically for power tools. Expertise in structural FEA tools, particularly ANSYS Mechanical and ANSYS DYNA. Advanced material modeling expertise for metals, plastics, rubber, concrete, wood, etc., including material damage and removal modeling, fatigue life prediction, and noise and vibration prediction. Experience in CFD workflows, such as: airflow, thermal (including conjugate heat transfer), and particle simulation. Experience in MBD workflows, such as: mechanism simulation with rigid and flexible bodies. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or MATLAB. Experience in CAE automation and AI applications. Experience in designing and executing validation tests to verify analytical models and calibrate results with empirical data. The Details: You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including: Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs. And More: We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to: Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal. Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences. Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices. What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us! We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 58,000 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights. This role provides technical leadership for handheld and stationary micro-hydraulic system design activities, including architecture definition, component selection, system analysis, prototype development, testing, and production launch support. The position requires strong cross-functional collaboration with electrical, software, motor controls, suppliers, and manufacturing teams to deliver high-quality hydraulic solutions that meet performance, cost, schedule, and reliability objectives. Experience contributing to intellectual property development, invention disclosures, and patent-support activities is highly valued. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent is required 7 to 10 years of mechanical design experience in micro-hydraulic system design and development. Demonstrated experience leading engineering projects or technical workstreams. Strong knowledge of hydraulic system principles, fluid power components, and system integration with background in high pressure micro-hydraulics. Experience creating and interpreting hydraulic schematics and engineering documentation. Experience creating and interpreting engineering drawings. Proficiency in hydraulic calculations, component sizing, and system troubleshooting. Experience with product development processes from concept through production launch. Knowledge of GD&T, DFM/DFA, DFMEA, and root cause analysis methodologies. Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with a global team, including suppliers and manufacturing operations. Ability to provide direction and mentorship to engineers and designers and lead project teams independently. Preferred Qualifications Experience with micro-hydraulic, high pressure compact hydraulic, or electro-hydraulic system applications. Familiarity with regulated, safety-critical, or high-reliability product environments. Experience supporting supplier qualification and component validation activities. Advanced analytical capability in system performance optimization and failure investigation. Leadership and Behavioral Expectations Self-motivated, creative, goal-oriented, and a strong team player. Holds self-accountable for results and behaviors, overcomes obstacles, and partners with others to deliver on commitments. Demonstrate understanding of quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives in a cross-functional and/or technical environment. Provides strong technical leadership and sound engineering judgment in a collaborative environment. Key Skills and Competencies Hydraulic system design and integration; specifically high pressure. Fluid power engineering Technical leadership System analysis and troubleshooting Product development and validation Cross-functional collaboration Risk assessment and DFMEA What You’ll Do As a Lead Project Engineer, you’ll be part of our Global Tools & Storage team located in Towson, MD. Specifically, you’ll: Lead the design and development of micro-hydraulic systems, subsystems, and components for product platforms and customer applications. Translate product requirements into micro-hydraulic architecture, subsystems, documentation, schematics, component specifications, and system performance criteria. Perform micro-hydraulic system sizing, pressure and flow calculations, load analysis, thermal analysis, and performance optimization. Lead technical decision-making for hydraulic system design activities across assigned engineering projects and technical workstreams. Develop and execute plans for project sample builds, prototype development, and engineering validation activities. Define validation plans and support testing activities to verify hydraulic system functionality, durability, efficiency, and safety. Troubleshoot hydraulic performance issues during prototype, testing, pilot, and production phases. Lead technical feasibility studies, design reviews, risk assessments, and DFMEA activities. Participate in hands-on concept development, prototyping, product testing, and data collection, while providing technical feedback and recommendations. Collaborate with motor controls, electrical, and software teams to integrate electro-hydraulic systems and ensure proper system behavior. Drive design standardization, modularity, and reuse of proven hydraulic solutions across programs. Support supplier selection, technical reviews, and component qualification activities. Ensure designs comply with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal engineering processes. Manage engineering deliverables, schedules, and technical execution for assigned projects. Successfully deliver projects that achieve quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives in a cross-functional environment. Participate in cross-functional meetings to communicate technical status, risks, issues, and recommended solutions. Support cost reduction, quality improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hydraulic systems. Provide direction, mentorship, and technical guidance to project engineers, engineers, and designers, and lead project teams independently. We need all kinds of people, so whether you want to become a technical expert, or grow your skills in multiple disciplines, you have come to the right spot. We also focus on having technical experts in each area that are there to guide you along the way, so you are never alone. The Job: As a Sr Director, Systems Engineering, you’ll be part of our Engineering & Technology – Americas & EMEA team working as a hybrid employee. This role will report directly to the Vice President, Engineering & Technology (Americas & EMEA) and will lead two sub-groups: a team of embedded Systems Engineers deployed to programs and the Engineering Processes & Quality group, which owns stage-gate technical readiness, engineering quality audits, and engineering standard work. You’ll get to: Build and lead the Systems Engineering capability for the Americas and EMEA engineering organization, including defining the operating model, engagement model with programs, and standard ways of working for embedded Systems Engineers deployed to programs. Recruit, develop, and deploy Systems Engineers who partner with program teams to lead requirements decomposition, interface control, integration analysis, and system-level technical readiness activities. Lead the implementation of systems-engineering methods, tools, and standard work across programs, including requirements management, traceability, and model-based systems engineering practices from customer need through verification. Drive verification and validation rigor by ensuring programs establish clear V&V plans, test coverage against critical-to-quality requirements, and evidence-based design review gates. Establish and scale the organization’s design-risk and functional-safety analysis discipline by driving consistent hazard analysis, DFMEA, and fault-tree analysis in partnership with Electrical Engineering and other functional teams. Lead the Engineering Processes & Quality group in deploying stage-gate technical readiness expectations, engineering quality audits, and engineering standard work across Americas and EMEA design centers in alignment with broader Engineering Excellence direction. Drive the Lead Project Engineer transformation by coaching design-center leaders and engineering teams to expand lead engineering accountability to full system ownership across mechanical, electrical, software, and industrial design. newJobs.title: VP, Marketing Science & Analytics
newJobs.descriptionText: GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S. Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans. About the Role: As the VP, Marketing Science & Analytics you will lead and manage a team of 10 to drive business growth through data. The role includes broad responsibility for centralizing customer segmentation strategy for media activation and growth, marketing analytics and BI, privacy and regulatory compliance, ad operations, and programmatic media strategy and activation. Your role is pivotal in shaping our marketing science vision, fostering innovation, and ensuring seamless collaboration with cross-functional teams. This role owns and drives the data-driven marketing vision within the marketing team. Key Responsibilities: 1. Team Leadership and Development: Lead a team of 10+, while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Oversee the recruitment, training, and development of marketing science talent. Follow all company and team guidelines and processes regarding talent management and team goal setting, tracking, and attainment. 2. Relationship Building, Strategic Planning, and Enterprise Alignment: Build/maintain strong relationships with data, engineering, finance, and other team leaders in and outside of marketing. Collaborate cross-functionally to provide consistent, reliable metrics, support decision-making, and guide strategic planning. Communicate plans effectively and secure enterprise alignment for initiatives. 3. Data-driven Activation - Programmatic Media Channels and Audience Strategy: Responsible for programmatic media, optimizing audience strategy for effective marketing campaigns, and developing optimization feedback loops from program data. Develop new data product capabilities to automate workflows that power programmatic media and data collection. Building for scale, while remaining flexible to accommodate different use cases and business goals. 4. Customer Segmentation and Marketing Automation: Develop customer segmentation approach for audience selection, including technical requirements for managing audiences, and strategies for personalized marketing activation and improved customer experience. Drive marketing automation around customer lifecycle touchpoints to enhance customer insights and business predictions for Next Best Actioning. 5. Marketing Analytics and Business Intelligence: Lead marketing attribution efforts, including the integration of lift measurement, econometric modeling, and channel measurement to assess the impact of various marketing channels and guide optimization decisions. Develop and refine strategies for measuring the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and optimizing budget/time allocation. Own all reporting and insights generation for the marketing department, assessing stakeholder needs and establishing the right reporting cadence and depth of insight to meet daily business decision making requirements. Compiles roll-up reports for department-wide view of business unit performance for team business review meetings, partner reporting needs, ELT meetings, board presentations, and other ad-hoc needs. Works closely with the consumer insights team to make proactive recommendations to marketing stakeholders and goes beyond reporting metrics to providing business context and explanations for material changes in the data over time (including technical measurement issues or methodology changes). Effectively communicate marketing measurement methodology to and aligns with cross functional partners. 6. Ad Operations, Privacy, Legal Compliance, and Martech Strategy: Take ownership of ad operations to ensure seamless execution of advertising campaigns. Ensure privacy and legal compliance in all marketing activities, staying abreast of industry regulations and internal process changes. Develop and implement Martech (Marketing Technology) strategies aligned with marketing science goals. Oversee the evaluation and integration of marketing technologies to enhance efficiency. 7. Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with industry-standard processes and new technologies (especially AI) in marketing science and implement improvements as needed to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of marketing data analysis. Skills & Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or above in a relevant field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or other science). 20+ years of experience in marketing science, value measurement, audience profiling, performance media, and experience with AI tools Tech-driven Healthcare and/or Retail experience a plus. Strong knowledge of statistics for marketing data interpretation and modeling. Experience in pipeline management to ensure data flow and integrity. Proficiency in data visualizations to effectively communicate marketing insights. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide a marketing science team. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with ability to find truth through data and use that understanding to drive organizational alignment from within marketing. Willingness to travel as needed to meet marketing goals Engineering teams are responsible for supporting appropriate security controls, including management, operational, and technical controls in addition to general GoodRx best practices, such as reading and adhering to the security policies and procedures, being vigilant and observant of potential security threats, etc. At GoodRx, pay ranges are determined based on work locations and may vary based on where the successful candidate is hired. GoodRx also offers additional benefits like mental wellness and financial wellness programs, fertility benefits, generous parental leave, pet insurance, supplemental life insurance for you and your dependents, company-paid short-term and long-term disability, and more! newJobs.title: Lead Project Engineer, Mechanical
newJobs.descriptionText: Lead Project Engineer - Micro Hydraulic We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. Come Build the World with Us This is the career you’ve been waiting for your whole life. Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 58,000 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black & Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights. Who We Are We’re the World’s largest tool company. We design and develop the tools that are used to change the world every day here in our engineering headquarters in Towson, Maryland. Our design teams are involved with every step of the process bringing these world class products to life. From conducting end user research to identify new needs, to designing and prototyping tools to ensure we meet our customers high expectations, to creating robust tests to guarantee the tools we make stand up to the toughest environments, our engineers own every aspect of the process along the way. Who You Are You’re a strong problem solver who loves digging into the details to fully understand what is going on. You have fixed a lot of problems, so you know how to sort out what is meaningful and what is not to be as efficient as possible. You have run DOE’s and done the statistics to make well informed decisions. You like getting your hands dirty and want to be the one disassembling a problem to find out what is broken and how to fix it. You are comfortable taking the lead, and enjoy coaching, teaching, and developing talent. You are looking for a high-visibility role where you can make an immediate and lasting impact. You can lead the complete design of a complex electro-mechanical product. You’re agile and adaptable but work with precision to ensure we deliver top-notch customer experiences, always. You want to work on a project where you can see the fruits of your labor come to life and enjoy seeing the finished product on the shelves of major retailers around the globe. You also have: Job Summary The Micro-Hydraulic Lead Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, integration, and validation of Micro-Hydraulic systems, subsystems, and components for product platforms and customer applications. This role provides technical leadership for handheld and stationary micro-hydraulic system design activities, including architecture definition, component selection, system analysis, prototype development, testing, and production launch support. The position requires strong cross-functional collaboration with electrical, software, motor controls, suppliers, and manufacturing teams to deliver high-quality hydraulic solutions that meet performance, cost, schedule, and reliability objectives. Experience contributing to intellectual property development, invention disclosures, and patent-support activities is highly valued. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent is required 7 to 10 years of mechanical design experience in micro-hydraulic system design and development. Demonstrated experience leading engineering projects or technical workstreams. Strong knowledge of hydraulic system principles, fluid power components, and system integration with background in high pressure micro-hydraulics. Experience creating and interpreting hydraulic schematics and engineering documentation. Experience creating and interpreting engineering drawings. Proficiency in hydraulic calculations, component sizing, and system troubleshooting. Experience with product development processes from concept through production launch. Knowledge of GD&T, DFM/DFA, DFMEA, and root cause analysis methodologies. Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with a global team, including suppliers and manufacturing operations. Ability to provide direction and mentorship to engineers and designers and lead project teams independently. Preferred Qualifications Experience with micro-hydraulic, high pressure compact hydraulic, or electro-hydraulic system applications. Familiarity with regulated, safety-critical, or high-reliability product environments. Experience supporting supplier qualification and component validation activities. Advanced analytical capability in system performance optimization and failure investigation. Leadership and Behavioral Expectations Self-motivated, creative, goal-oriented, and a strong team player. Holds self-accountable for results and behaviors, overcomes obstacles, and partners with others to deliver on commitments. Demonstrate understanding of quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives in a cross-functional and/or technical environment. Provides strong technical leadership and sound engineering judgment in a collaborative environment. Key Skills and Competencies Hydraulic system design and integration; specifically high pressure. Fluid power engineering Technical leadership System analysis and troubleshooting Product development and validation Cross-functional collaboration Risk assessment and DFMEA What You’ll Do As a Lead Project Engineer, you’ll be part of our Global Tools & Storage team located in Towson, MD. Specifically, you’ll: Lead the design and development of micro-hydraulic systems, subsystems, and components for product platforms and customer applications. Translate product requirements into micro-hydraulic architecture, subsystems, documentation, schematics, component specifications, and system performance criteria. Perform micro-hydraulic system sizing, pressure and flow calculations, load analysis, thermal analysis, and performance optimization. Lead technical decision-making for hydraulic system design activities across assigned engineering projects and technical workstreams. Develop and execute plans for project sample builds, prototype development, and engineering validation activities. Define validation plans and support testing activities to verify hydraulic system functionality, durability, efficiency, and safety. Troubleshoot hydraulic performance issues during prototype, testing, pilot, and production phases. Lead technical feasibility studies, design reviews, risk assessments, and DFMEA activities. Participate in hands-on concept development, prototyping, product testing, and data collection, while providing technical feedback and recommendations. Collaborate with motor controls, electrical, and software teams to integrate electro-hydraulic systems and ensure proper system behavior. Drive design standardization, modularity, and reuse of proven hydraulic solutions across programs. Support supplier selection, technical reviews, and component qualification activities. Ensure designs comply with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal engineering processes. Manage engineering deliverables, schedules, and technical execution for assigned projects. Successfully deliver projects that achieve quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives in a cross-functional environment. Participate in cross-functional meetings to communicate technical status, risks, issues, and recommended solutions. Support cost reduction, quality improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hydraulic systems. Provide direction, mentorship, and technical guidance to project engineers, engineers, and designers, and lead project teams independently. Benefits & Perks You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, 401k, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners. Strong SQL/data validation skills and familiarity with BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong experience translating business needs into epics/features/user stories and functional specifications. Proven leadership in testing and release readiness (UAT leadership, defect triage, go-live/hypercare). Design, build, and operate secure backend services, APIs, and microservices that support websites, mobile applications, customer registration, warranty, service, and other digital products. Lead the architecture and operation of cloud-native solutions and shared services running on AWS. Build reusable platform capabilities that enable multiple product teams across the organization. Establish engineering best practices for DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, reliability, and platform performance. newJobs.descriptionText: McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. Résumé du poste L’ Analyste du transport est responsable de la gestion de bout en bout, de l’optimisation et de la gouvernance des activités de transport qui soutiennent la division Solutions technologiques de McKesson. La personne titulaire du poste agit à titre d’experte en matière pour le transport au sein de l’organisation et assume la responsabilité du transport entrant et sortant, des installations, des relocalisations, de la logistique des salons professionnels, de la conformité douanière, de la gestion des transporteurs, de l’optimisation du fret, de l’exécution de la stratégie de transport et du rendement budgétaire du transport. En collaboration avec l’Analyste associé senior du transport, la personne titulaire du poste gère de façon autonome les activités de transport, élabore et tient à jour les normes de transport, mène des initiatives d’amélioration continue et collabore avec les parties prenantes internes ainsi qu’avec les partenaires logistiques externes afin d’assurer des services de transport rentables, conformes, évolutifs et de grande qualité. Le poste fournit des analyses, un leadership opérationnel et des recommandations stratégiques visant à améliorer le rendement du transport, la satisfaction de la clientèle et l’efficacité globale de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Section A - Principales responsabilités Gestion des activités de transport (25 %) Gérer tous les volets des activités de transport, notamment les expéditions entrantes et sortantes, les services de messagerie, les envois LTL, les chargements complets, les services de livraison sur mesure, les installations, les relocalisations et les expéditions internationales. Veiller à ce que les expéditions respectent les exigences en matière de service à la clientèle, de qualité, de réglementation et de livraison. Surveiller les délais de transport et intervenir de façon proactive en cas de risque ou de perturbation du service. Coordonner les exigences logistiques liées aux installations chez les clients, aux déménagements de bureaux, aux déploiements d’équipement et aux projets spéciaux. Agir comme principal point d’escalade pour les enjeux opérationnels liés au transport. Veiller à ce que les activités de transport soient exécutées conformément aux politiques de McKesson, aux normes de qualité et aux exigences réglementaires. Stratégie de transport, gouvernance des transporteurs et gestion des partenaires logistiques (20 %) Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de transport de Solutions technologiques McKesson et veiller à ce que les capacités de transport soutiennent la croissance de l’entreprise, l’expérience client, l’efficacité opérationnelle, l’atténuation des risques et les objectifs de coûts. Élaborer et exécuter des plans d’optimisation du transport axés sur le rendement du service, l’efficacité du réseau, l’évolutivité et la réduction des coûts de transport. Établir des processus de gouvernance des transporteurs, notamment des fiches de rendement, des revues d’affaires trimestrielles, le suivi des niveaux de service, des plans de mesures correctives et des initiatives d’amélioration continue. Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs de transport, les courtiers en douane, les transitaires, les fournisseurs d’entreposage et les partenaires logistiques tiers. Diriger les initiatives d’approvisionnement en transport, les appels d’offres de transport, les renouvellements de contrats et les activités de sélection des partenaires de transport. Participer aux négociations de contrats de transport et formuler des recommandations quant à la sélection des transporteurs. Évaluer et recommander des changements au réseau de transport, des stratégies d’acheminement, des possibilités d’optimisation des modes et des solutions logistiques de rechange. Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs tiers respectent les normes de McKesson en matière de qualité, de sécurité, de conformité et de service à la clientèle. Gestion du rendement du transport et responsabilité budgétaire (15 %) Assumer la responsabilité des rapports sur le rendement du transport, notamment les indicateurs clés de rendement, les tableaux de bord, les fiches de rendement des transporteurs, les mesures de service et l’analyse des dépenses de transport. Élaborer les prévisions budgétaires annuelles du transport et soutenir la planification du transport à long terme. Surveiller les dépenses de transport par rapport au budget et repérer les risques, les tendances, les écarts et les possibilités d’économies. Diriger les revues des dépenses de transport et formuler des recommandations visant à améliorer l’efficience des coûts tout en respectant les engagements en matière de service et envers la clientèle. Présenter à la direction le rendement du transport, l’état du budget, les tendances de coûts et les recommandations d’amélioration. Repérer les lacunes opérationnelles et diriger l’élaboration de plans de mesures correctives afin d’améliorer le service, les coûts, la qualité, la conformité et l’efficacité du transport. Soutenir la planification des activités en fournissant des estimations de coûts de transport et des recommandations logistiques pour les initiatives stratégiques. Conformité commerciale, douanes et logistique internationale (15 %) Assumer la responsabilité des activités de conformité liées aux douanes, aux droits, aux importations et aux exportations. Développer et maintenir une expertise en matière de réglementation du transport international, d’Incoterms, de documentation douanière et d’exigences commerciales. Coordonner les expéditions transfrontalières et les activités de transport international concernant le Canada, les États-Unis, l’Europe et d’autres destinations internationales. Veiller au respect de toutes les exigences applicables en matière de transport, de douanes, de réglementation et de politiques d’entreprise. Gérer, au besoin, les relations avec les courtiers en douane et les organismes de réglementation. Soutenir les audits internes et externes liés au transport et à la conformité commerciale. Programmes logistiques spécialisés (15 %) Gérer le soutien en transport et en logistique pour les salons professionnels, les démonstrations, les événements clients, les installations et les déploiements d’équipement spécialisé. Coordonner les exigences de transport avec les équipes de la Gestion des produits, des Ventes, de l’Approvisionnement, des Opérations clients et de l’Entrepôt. Soutenir les mouvements de stocks et les activités logistiques liés aux initiatives d’affaires stratégiques. Veiller à ce que l’équipement soit livré, installé, relocalisé et retourné conformément aux exigences opérationnelles et aux exigences des clients. Amélioration continue et leadership de projet (10 %) Diriger des initiatives d’amélioration continue liées au transport et axées sur la qualité du service, l’expérience client, l’efficacité opérationnelle, la conformité et la réduction des coûts. Établir et tenir à jour les processus, les normes, les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et les pratiques exemplaires en matière de transport. Évaluer les mesures de rendement du transport et les références sectorielles afin de repérer les possibilités d’amélioration. Diriger des projets interfonctionnels auxquels participent la Chaîne d’approvisionnement, l’Approvisionnement, les Finances, les Opérations, le Service à la clientèle, les Ventes et la Gestion des produits. Évaluer les technologies émergentes en transport, les systèmes de gestion du transport (TMS) et les solutions logistiques. Diriger les activités de mise en œuvre liées aux améliorations des systèmes de transport et des processus opérationnels. Promouvoir une culture d’excellence opérationnelle et d’exécution bien du premier coup (Right First Time). Section B - Exigences principales Formation Baccalauréat ou diplôme d’études collégiales en gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, en logistique, en transport, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe. Une certification professionnelle CITT, CSCMP, APICS, PMP ou l’équivalent est considérée comme un atout. Expérience De 4 à 8 ans d’expérience progressive en transport, en logistique ou en chaîne d’approvisionnement. Expérience de la gestion d’activités de transport nationales et internationales. Expérience en conformité douanière, en importation et exportation ainsi qu’en réglementation du transport. Expérience de la gestion de fournisseurs de transport, de courtiers en douane, de transitaires et de partenaires logistiques. Expérience de l’élaboration de stratégies de transport, de la gestion des dépenses de transport et de la direction d’initiatives d’amélioration des processus. Expérience démontrée dans la gestion autonome des priorités opérationnelles et dans l’influence auprès de parties prenantes interfonctionnelles. Section C - Connaissances et compétences Connaissance approfondie des activités de transport, de la gestion du fret, de la conformité douanière et des processus de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Compréhension approfondie des Incoterms, de la réglementation sur l’importation et l’exportation, des droits de douane et de la logistique internationale. Solide connaissance de l’approvisionnement en transporteurs, des contrats de transport, de l’optimisation du fret et de la budgétisation du transport. Capacités avancées d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Compétences intermédiaires à avancées en Microsoft Excel et expérience avec Salesforce, Power BI ou d’autres outils d���intelligence d’affaires. Solides compétences en gestion de projet, en organisation et en gestion des parties prenantes. Capacité démontrée à collaborer et à travailler en équipe, tout en étant en mesure de travailler de façon autonome et de prendre des décisions opérationnelles et commerciales judicieuses. Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. Capacité d’influencer les parties prenantes et de mener le changement sans autorité directe. Excellentes compétences en anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, pour communiquer avec les fournisseurs des États-Unis et d’outre-mer. **************************** Job Summary The Transportation Analyst is responsible for the end-to-end management, optimization, and governance of transportation operations supporting McKesson Technology Solutions. The role serves as the organization's transportation subject matter expert and is accountable for inbound and outbound transportation, installations, relocations, trade show logistics, customs compliance, carrier management, freight optimization, transportation strategy execution, and transportation budget performance. Together with the Sr. Associate Transportation Analyst, the incumbent independently manages transportation activities, develops and maintains transportation standards, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborates with internal stakeholders and external logistics partners to ensure cost-effective, compliant, scalable, and high-quality transportation services. The role provides analytical insight, operational leadership, and strategic recommendations to improve transportation performance, customer satisfaction, and overall supply chain efficiency. Section A – Key Responsibilities Transportation Operations Management (25%) Manage all aspects of transportation operations including inbound, outbound, courier, LTL, truckload, white-glove, installation, relocation, and international shipments. Ensure shipments meet customer service, quality, regulatory, and delivery requirements. Monitor transportation lead times and proactively address service risks or disruptions. Coordinate logistics requirements associated with customer installations, office relocations, equipment deployments, and special projects. Act as the primary escalation point for transportation-related operational issues. Ensure transportation activities are executed in accordance with McKesson policies, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. Transportation Strategy, Carrier Governance and Logistics Partner Management (20%) Own the transportation strategy for McKesson Technology Solutions, ensuring transportation capabilities support business growth, customer experience, operational efficiency, risk mitigation, and cost objectives. Develop and execute transportation optimization plans focused on service performance, network efficiency, scalability, and freight cost reduction. Establish carrier governance processes, including performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, service-level monitoring, corrective action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives. Manage relationships with transportation providers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, warehousing providers, and third-party logistics partners. Lead carrier sourcing initiatives, transportation RFPs, contract renewals, and transportation partner selection activities. Participate in transportation contract negotiations and recommend carrier selection decisions. Evaluate and recommend transportation network changes, routing strategies, mode optimization opportunities, and alternative logistics solutions. Ensure third-party providers operate in accordance with McKesson quality, safety, compliance, and customer service standards. Transportation Performance Management and Budget Ownership (15%) Own transportation performance reporting, including KPIs, dashboards, carrier scorecards, service metrics, and freight spend analysis. Develop annual transportation budget forecasts and support long-range transportation planning. Monitor transportation expenditures against budget and identify risks, trends, variances, and cost-saving opportunities. Lead freight spend reviews and provide recommendations to improve cost efficiency while maintaining service and customer commitments. Present transportation performance, budget status, cost trends, and improvement recommendations to leadership. Identify operational gaps and lead development of corrective action plans to improve service, cost, quality, compliance, and transportation efficiency. Support business planning by providing transportation cost estimates and logistics recommendations for strategic initiatives. Trade Compliance, Customs and International Logistics (15%) Own customs, duty, import, and export compliance activities. Develop and maintain expertise related to international transportation regulations, Incoterms, customs documentation, and trade requirements. Coordinate cross-border shipments and international transportation activities involving Canada, the United States, Europe, and other international destinations. Ensure compliance with all applicable transportation, customs, regulatory, and corporate requirements. Manage relationships with customs brokers and regulatory agencies as required. Support internal and external audits related to transportation and trade compliance. Specialized Logistics Programs (15%) Manage transportation and logistics support for trade shows, demonstrations, customer events, installations, and specialized equipment deployments. Coordinate transportation requirements with Product Management, Sales, Procurement, Customer Operations, and Warehouse teams. Support inventory movements and logistics activities associated with strategic business initiatives. Ensure equipment is delivered, installed, relocated, and returned in accordance with operational and customer requirements. Continuous Improvement and Project Leadership (10%) Lead transportation-related continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, customer experience, operational efficiency, compliance, and cost reduction. Establish and maintain transportation processes, standards, SOPs, and best practices. Evaluate transportation metrics and industry benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities. Lead cross-functional projects involving Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Customer Service, Sales, and Product Management. Evaluate emerging transportation technologies, transportation management systems (TMS), and logistics solutions. Lead implementation activities associated with transportation system enhancements and operational process improvements. Promote a culture of operational excellence and Right First Time execution. Section B – Key Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree or College Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Business Administration, or a related field. CITT, CSCMP, APICS, PMP, or equivalent professional certification considered an asset. Experience 4 to 8 years of progressive transportation, logistics, or supply chain experience. Experience managing domestic and international transportation operations. Experience with customs compliance, import/export activities, and transportation regulations. Experience managing transportation providers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners. Experience developing transportation strategies, managing freight spend, and leading process improvement initiatives. Proven experience independently managing operational priorities and influencing cross-functional stakeholders. Section C – Knowledge and Skills Advanced knowledge of transportation operations, freight management, customs compliance, and supply chain processes. In-depth understanding of Incoterms, import/export regulations, customs duties, and international logistics. Strong knowledge of carrier sourcing, transportation contracts, freight optimization, and transportation budgeting. Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with Salesforce, Power BI, or other business intelligence tools. Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to be a team player and work in a team environment, but also able to work independently and make sound operational and business decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to influence stakeholders and drive change without direct authority. Strong English communication skills (verbal and written) for communicating with US & overseas suppliers. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. Yahoo Mail teams in three words: Your personal database. We are looking for an advanced technical leader who views AI as an essential accelerator to scale their personal and team impact, and who thrives in an evolving, AI-augmented development environment. Responsibilities Architect, design, and guide the development of high-performing, scalable, and highly available backend systems for Yahoo Mail using Java and C++ on Unix/Linux platforms. Drive technical strategy and establish unified architectural standards across multiple engineering squads for mail APIs, low-latency metadata systems, and elastic storage solutions. Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies in backend engineering, leveraging approved AI-assisted tools (e.g., CodeWhisperer Professional / Amazon Q Developer) to replace manual, repetitive coding and unit testing tasks with optimized workflows. Act as a technical validator, establishing the standards for reviewing, refining, and testing AI-generated architectural proposals and code outputs to ensure strict security, performance, and style compliance. Mentor senior engineering staff, conducting rigorous design and system reviews while fostering a culture of continuous learning, technical curiosity, and experimentation. Collaborate actively with cross-functional stakeholders—including Product Management, Design, Security, and Cloud Infrastructure teams—to translate product visions into scalable technical architectures. Minimum Qualifications BS in Computer Science (or equivalent practical experience) with a minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience. Specialized expertise in high-concurrency backend development using Java, C++, and Unix/Linux systems. Deep conceptual and practical understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures, multi-threading, memory management, and advanced algorithms). Solid experience with search algorithms, as well as the design and query optimization of both Relational and NoSQL database architectures. Demonstrated experience utilizing developer-facing AI productivity tools (such as CodeWhisperer or Copilot) to accelerate code output, optimize design patterns, and streamline testing. Strong understanding of HTTP and TCP/IP protocols, with experience troubleshooting network-level performance and latency constraints. Proven track record of technically leading complex engineering initiatives with minimal guidance and guiding teams through ambiguous technical challenges. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing, deploying, and operating highly distributed, large-scale mail applications and standard communication protocols. Familiarity with leveraging secure LLM endpoints and frameworks (e.g., AWS Bedrock / SageMaker) for metadata tagging, intelligent search, or backend telemetry analysis. Comprehensive experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern test automation frameworks. Deep practical experience with GCP or AWS cloud architectures, particularly in managing hybrid cloud migrations and optimizing cloud resource efficiency. Commitment to agile engineering practices (such as SCRUM or Kanban), actively driving workflow improvements and retrospective alignment. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results. A Little About Us Yahoo is a global media and tech company that connects people to their interests. We reach nearly 900 million people around the world, bringing them closer to what they love—from finance and sports, to shopping, gaming, and news—through trusted products, content, and technology that fuel their day. For partners, we provide a full-stack platform that helps businesses amplify growth and build meaningful connections across advertising, search, and media. Within Yahoo Games, our mission is to make games a natural extension of the daily Yahoo experience—easy to discover, fun to play, and rewarding to return to. We are building a modern casual games platform that combines high-quality content, strong platform capabilities, and the power of the Yahoo ecosystem to drive engagement at scale. A Lot About You We are seeking a creative, analytical, and results-driven Senior Product Manager (Games) to help define and scale the Yahoo Games portfolio. This role is primarily responsible for driving the growth, engagement, and evolution of our games portfolio, ensuring we deliver a steady pipeline of high-quality experiences that players return to daily. You will lead the development of both first-party and third-party games, owning the strategy and execution required to build a compelling, sustainable portfolio. This includes shaping new game concepts, partnering with internal and external developers, and continuously optimizing performance through data, experimentation, and player insight. In addition to games, you will collaborate with our discovery and platform teams to ensure strong alignment to improve how users find and engage with games and platform features that reinforce retention and repeat play. You are equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing day-to-day. You bring a strong understanding of game systems, player behavior, and live operations, and you use data, UXR, and experimentation to drive outcomes. You are also excited about leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product development, enhance workflows, and unlock new opportunities across gameplay, personalization, and content creation. Lead the development and launch of first-party games, third-party integrations, and supporting platform features. Partner with Game Design, Engineering, Product Design, Analytics, and Production to deliver high-quality, engaging game experiences. Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, iterative environment. Strong judgment in evaluating AI-generated outputs and validating data integrity to ensure high-quality product decision-making. newJobs.descriptionText: About TailorCare TailorCare is transforming the experience of specialty care. Our comprehensive care program takes a profoundly personal, evidence-based approach to improving patient outcomes for joint, back, and muscle conditions. By carefully assessing patients' symptoms, health histories, preferences, and goals with predictive data and the latest evidence-based guidelines, we help patients choose and navigate the most effective treatment pathway for them every step of the way. TailorCare values the experiences and perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds. We are a highly collaborative, curious, and determined team passionate about scaling a high-growth start-up to improve the lives of those in pain. TailorCare is a remote-first company with our corporate office located in Nashville. About the Role As a Care Advocate, you will be responsible for engaging prospective patients through proactive outbound calls and multichannel outreach to drive awareness and enrollment in TailorCare’s musculoskeletal (MSK) care navigation program. You’ll often serve as the first point of contact, guiding patients through the value of our services and creating a personalized, empathetic, and compelling experience. This is a high-volume, outbound call center role focused on healthcare engagement, where you will connect with patients and their caregivers to identify barriers and motivate them to take action toward improved musculoskeletal (MSK) care. This is a non-exempt (hourly) position. Location & Schedule This is a 100% remote role. Candidates must be available to work hours aligned with Eastern, Central, or Mountain Time Zones. Responsibilities Conduct high-volume outbound calls and multichannel outreach (phone, SMS, email) to eligible patients to introduce TailorCare’s services and support program enrollment. Build and maintain a working knowledge of TailorCare’s MSK program, including core conditions, care pathways, eligibility criteria, and the enrollment process, to explain the program clearly and accurately. Clearly and empathetically communicate TailorCare’s value proposition, tailoring the conversation to patient goals, health literacy, concerns, and motivations. Build trust and rapport quickly using active listening, genuine empathy, and a compassionate approach that puts patients at ease and encourages engagement. Develop and apply foundational motivational interviewing (MI) techniques — including open-ended questioning, affirmations, reflective listening, and summarizing — to support patient-centered conversations. Identify and address common patient questions, barriers, or objections using established techniques while maintaining a calm, supportive tone; seek guidance and escalate appropriately when patient needs or situations fall outside your scope. Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and consistency across all patient interactions, representing TailorCare’s values and mission. Document all patient interactions accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner within internal systems to support care coordination, data integrity, and reporting. Meet or exceed performance targets related to outreach volume, patient engagement, caseload management, and call quality. Use personal performance data and coaching feedback to identify trends in your own outreach and drive continuous self-improvement. Use AI-enabled tools and new technologies with curiosity, openness, and responsibility to improve personal productivity and outreach effectiveness. Adapt to changing scripts, tools, and workflows with a positive, growth-oriented mindset. Coordinate patient handoffs with internal care teams. Participate in regular team meetings and daily standups, contributing to a positive, inclusive culture of learning and collaboration. Surface observations, feedback, and ideas on patient trends, outreach barriers, or script effectiveness to appropriate team members for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Required: Experience in outbound call center, inside sales, telephonic outreach, or patient engagement roles—preferably in a healthcare, health plan, or health tech environment. Strong written and verbal communication, persuasion, and active listening skills. Willingness to learn and apply motivational interviewing techniques in patient conversations. Ability to manage a high call volume while maintaining accuracy and empathy. Comfortable working with productivity targets and quality metrics in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment. Ability to use personal performance data and feedback to drive self-improvement. High comfort level with technology, including contact center platforms, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), documentation tools, and Google Suite. Openness and adaptability to new technologies, including responsible use of AI-enabled tools. Ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% as needed for onsite meetings, team collaboration, and company events. Preferred: Familiarity with motivational interviewing and/or patient coaching strategies. Experience working with Medicare populations and a basic understanding of Medicare Health Plans. Knowledge of medical terminology. Previous experience with remote/telemedicine care delivery. What's In It For You Meaningful Work: We are dedicated to our mission and deeply value our patients and each other. Each day offers the opportunity to make a positive impact. Work Environment: We operate as a remote-first company with options for a hybrid work model in Nashville. Time Off: Our generous paid time off (PTO) and holiday plans ensure you have ample time to rest and recharge. Family First: We offer paid parental leave and support a healthy work-life balance, encouraging flexibility and autonomy. We love talking about our family and pets! Comprehensive Benefits: From Day 1, employees enjoy medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness resources and an employer HSA contribution. Fair Compensation: We are committed to equitable pay for all team members and support your future goals with a 401k plan that includes employer matching. Community: We foster an inclusive environment where you can rely on your teammates, share honest feedback, and feel comfortable being your authentic self at work each day. newJobs.descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Cloud Security Engineer to own our cloud security posture and runtime detection capabilities. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role focused on ensuring our live cloud environments and containerized workloads are hardened, continuously monitored, and generating the right signals for our security operations function. This role is about detection architecture, posture management, and runtime visibility. You will be the primary owner of our CrowdStrike platform, working closely with our MDR providers to ensure alert fidelity, tuning, and appropriate escalation. You will also evaluate and potentially implement a cloud SIEM. This isn’t a role where you watch dashboards and write tickets. You’ll be the person who defines how we detect threats, decides how we respond to them, and has the autonomy to fix what you find. If you’re tired of maintaining legacy tooling, navigating slow change management processes, or writing findings that disappear into a backlog, this is the opposite of that. We’re a SaaS-first company running a modern, cloud-native stack. We ship fixes, not tickets. What You'll Contribute Own CrowdStrike Falcon configuration, ensuring policies are appropriately scoped, tuned, and generating actionable alerts. Partner with MDR to define alert routing, triage thresholds, and escalation logic, ensuring the right signals reach the right team. Monitor cloud environments (primarily AWS) for security posture drift: misconfigured IAM roles, overly permissive security groups, exposed storage, and non-compliant resource configurations. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.About the Team Capital One’s Enterprise Payments team is defining the roadmap that will enable the bank’s overall digital payments strategy, modernizing existing payment types and introducing the latest innovations. In an industry rooted in mainframe systems and batch processes, we are driving toward a cloud-based, API/microservice architected, real-time data environment. The world is moving toward faster payments and Capital One is not just ahead of the curve, but defining it. We are a tech-centric company and an innovation laboratory within the only founder-led, top 10 bank in the U.S.The Product Manager for the Enterprise Payments team plays a critical role in achieving our goals. This is a highly collaborative role, where the individual will work closely with a team of product managers as well partnering with designers, engineers, data scientists, operations, and business partners to transform the experience for all of our customers. Through this collaboration, the individual will shape the product strategy and then develop, launch, and enhance payments experiences that will meet the unique needs of our customers, ranging from consumer to small business to commercial personas across both lending and deposit products.As a Manager on the Enterprise Payment Platforms Product team, you will own the Scheduler Platform — Capital One's core data store for all scheduled transaction generation, storage, and execution across millions of bank customers. This is a high-leverage infrastructure product that sits at the center of Capital One's most critical payment initiatives supporting Retail, Small Business, and Commercial Bank. You will lead product strategy and delivery for a platform that handles complex scheduling logic across multiple payment rails — including Internal Transfers, ACH, RTP, Zelle, Wire, and Check — while simultaneously expanding into next-generation capabilities like Predictive Scheduling and real-time payment enablement.This role is for someone who is comfortable defining product direction in ambiguous, high-stakes environments, translating enterprise-scale technical architecture into clear business outcomes, and driving alignment across partners who have competing priorities and tight delivery windows.Capital One Product FrameworkIn this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product Management:Human Centered - newJobs.descriptionText: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for a Principal Data Engineer to be the most senior individual contributor on the Data Platform Engineering (DPE) team at Hims & Hers. In this role, you will define and align the architectural vision for our data platform with business goals – working in close partnership with product, engineering, and data science leadership. Your scope is org-wide: you will set technical direction across every surface DPE owns, drive the highest-stakes architectural decisions, and establish the standards that the entire data engineering discipline operates by. Our platform serves millions of patients across telehealth, prescription, and wellness products. It runs on GCP BigQuery, Airflow on Astronomer/EKS, dbt, Confluent Kafka, Databricks Delta Lake, and Terraform/OpenTofu – and it is in active, consequential evolution: a net-new streaming platform, and a lower environments strategy being built from scratch. You will own those architectural bets. YOU WILL: - Own the long-term technical architecture for DPE across ingestion, orchestration, event streaming, and the platform infrastructure that enables transformation and serving - driving the highest-stakes decisions for the CDC-based streaming platform (Kafka → Flink → BigQuery), orchestration platform evaluation, and lower environment strategy - Chair Architecture Review Committee (ARC) decisions; act as the primary technical DRI for cross-team, multi-system, and cost-impacting changes - Establish and enforce engineering standards and production readiness criteria across all DPE-owned systems - testing requirements, CI/CD patterns, observability-as-code, logging standards, data contracts, Schema Registry governance, and what 'production-ready' means for emerging streaming and CDC capabilities - Own data quality and observability architecture - dbt anomaly detection frameworks, schema validation, data drift alerting, and the platform standards that ensure consumers can trust the data they build on - Define the technical strategy for self-service analytics: what platform capabilities enable Analytics Engineering to work independently, what guardrails prevent downstream breakage, and how DPE reduces its bottleneck over time - Own evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing governance of DPE-managed tooling - Fivetran, Confluent, and equivalent platforms, including contract management, cost tracking, and deprecation decisions - Own data sharing and egress patterns - access provisioning, cross-team data contracts, reverse ETL (Hightouch), and governed consumption paths for internal and external consumers - Drive cost governance for platform infrastructure - BigQuery slot reservations, query optimization, partition strategies, orchestration rightsizing, and cloud spend accountability across the full DPE stack - Lead incident response for platform-level P1/P2 incidents: act as technical escalation point, facilitate blameless RCAs, and drive systemic fixes that prevent recurrence - Produce exemplary technical artifacts - architecture decision records, solution design docs, RFCs - that create alignment and become the team's reference standard - Mentor and elevate Staff and Senior Data Engineers; raise the technical ceiling through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on pairing - Partner cross-functionally with ML/Data Science, legal/security/compliance, and DevOps to deliver platform capabilities that are ML-ready, compliant with HIPAA/GDPR, and hardened at the infrastructure layer - Contribute hands-on to critical path work YOU HAVE: - 15+ years of professional experience designing, building, and owning data platform architecture at company scale - Demonstrated ability to define and align architectural vision with business goals across an entire engineering organization - Deep expertise in cloud-native data platforms across GCP primary (BigQuery, GCS, Dataflow); AWS operational familiarity required (EKS-based Airflow) - BigQuery strongly preferred; multi-cloud fluency is required, not a plus - Hands-on experience with the modern data stack: experience governing dbt at platform scale, Airflow/Astronomer, Kafka/Confluent, Databricks/Spark, Fivetran, and data sharing/activation platforms (Hightouch or equivalent) - Experience designing and operating event streaming pipelines at scale - including Schema Registry, data contracts, and consumer lag management - Proven track record establishing engineering standards across multiple teams and driving adoption without direct authority - Experience owning data quality frameworks - dbt testing, anomaly detection, schema validation, and data observability tooling - Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks in a regulated environment - HIPAA/PHI handling, data classification, access controls, audit logging, and GDPR - Experience leading incident response for data platform outages - blameless RCA, systemic root cause identification, and operational improvement - Infrastructure-as-code fluency - Terraform or equivalent; you treat infrastructure changes like software changes - Strong Python and SQL skills; comfortable writing, reviewing, and raising the bar on production-grade pipeline code - Clear written communication: you produce design docs and RFCs that build alignment, not confusion. Comfort operating in ambiguity - you define the path, you don't wait for it to be defined PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Delta Lake in production at scale - Experience with CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns and Flink for real-time data processing - PySpark/SparkSQL for large-scale batch and streaming workloads - Experience driving a BigQuery → Databricks Lakehouse migration or equivalent cloud data warehouse migration - Experience with MLOps - partnering with ML engineers on model training pipelines, feature stores, and experimentation infrastructure - Go or Python service development for Kafka producers and consumers - Experience at a direct-to-consumer healthcare or telehealth company with HIPAA and GDPR obligations - Familiarity with SOX compliance controls in a data engineering context OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS): - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave - Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) - 401k benefits with employer matching contribution - Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. newJobs.descriptionText: Über uns Slalom ist ein modernes Beratungsunternehmen, das sich auf Strategie, Technologie und IT-Transformation konzentriert. In acht Ländern und 49 Offices auf der ganzen Welt haben unsere Berater:innen die Möglichkeit, nach dem lokalen Ansatz schnell bei unseren Kunden zu sein und vor Ort zu helfen. Slalom wurde 2001 gegründet, hat seinen Hauptsitz in Seattle und ist organisch auf über 12.000 Mitarbeitende gewachsen. Slalom wurde acht Jahre in Folge von Fortune zu einem der 100 besten Arbeitgeber ernannt und wird regelmäßig von seinen Mitarbeitenden als bester Arbeitsplatz ausgezeichnet. Das sind deine täglichen Aufgaben Du planst, entwickelst und lieferst Softwarekomponenten und Cloud-Infrastrukturen für Kundenprojekte, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum erfolgreichen Deployment CI/CD-Pipelines und Automatisierung sind dein Tagesgeschäft, wobei du durch Code Reviews und Best Practices stets eine hohe Qualität und Stabilität sicherstellst AI-Tools wie GitHub Copilot, Claude oder Codex setzt du gezielt ein, um effizienter zu arbeiten und innovative Lösungen für Kunden und interne Prozesse zu entwickeln Du arbeitest eng mit multidisziplinären Teams zusammen, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und coachst Kolleg:innen sowohl in Kundenprojekten als auch in internen Initiativen Die Weiterentwicklung von Slalom liegt dir am Herzen, du bringst dich aktiv in die Verbesserung interner Prozesse ein und stärkst unsere technische Community Das bringst du mit Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise mit einem Einstieg im Software Engineering und einer zunehmenden Spezialisierung im Bereich DevOps und Platform Engineering Dein technisches Toolkit umfasst gängige DevOps-Tools wie GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, etc. Du weißt, wie man sie effektiv einsetzt, und hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure oder Google Cloud Platform Erste Kenntnisse in Observability-Tools wie Grafana, Datadog oder New Relic sind ein willkommenes Plus Du hast bereits fortgeschrittene Erfahrungen im Deployment und in der Arbeit mit AI-gestützten Tools wie GitHub Copilot, Codex oder Claude gesammelt und nutzt sie aktiv, um effizienter zu arbeiten Delivery ist deine Antriebskraft, du denkst lösungsorientiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und bringst eine hands-on Mentalität mit, die dich motiviert, Dinge voranzutreiben und abzuschließen Du verfügst über sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (min. C1-Level) Deine Benefits Hybrides Arbeiten im Home Office und in unseren modernen Offices in den Herzen von München, Düsseldorf oder Frankfurt am Main Bis zu 30 Tage Arbeiten im Ausland nach Absprache jährlich möglich 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit des Erwerbs von bis zu zehn zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen pro Jahr Eine monatliche individuelle Mobilitätspauschale für private Reisen mit der Bahn, Auto, Flugzeug, Rad, Tank- oder Werkstattkosten Monatliche Smartphonepauschale von 100€ (Brutto) und freie Wahl deines Laptops (Apple oder HP) Mit deiner Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM Wellpass hast du Zugang zu über 2.800 Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnesseinrichtungen sowie zu Apps und Home Workouts Jährliches Budget von rund 300€ für dein Well-being. Ob Yoga, Fitnesskurs, Massage oder doch einer Spende für einen guten Zweck, du entscheidest Wir kümmern uns um deine Zukunft – mit einer jährlichen Zahlung in unseren Pensionsfond (4% des Grundgehalts) Zwei Impact Days für Volunteering in deiner Community pro Jahr Du bist uns wichtig – neben Coaching und weiteren Unterstützungsprogrammen bieten wir umfangreiche Versicherungspläne für dich und deine Familie an Regelmäßige Teamevents, Get together und Lunch & Learns mit den besten Kollegen:innen in unseren zentralen Offices Was uns ausmacht Unsere zehn „Slalom Core Values“ sind ein fester Bestandteil von allem, was wir bei Slalom tun, und prägen unsere mitarbeiterzentrierte Kultur. Wir fördern die Vielfalt am Arbeitsplatz und stellen sicher, dass alle unsere Mitarbeitenden ihr Potenzial voll entfalten können, unabhängig von ihrem persönlichen, kulturellen und sozialen Background. Wir bauen Teams auf, die die Vielfalt der Communities widerspiegeln, für die wir arbeiten. Come as you are! Deshalb Slalom Obwohl Slalom schon seit 2001 ein globaler Player ist, befinden wir uns in einer für unsere Branche besonderen Ausgangslage und werden nach wie vor von unseren Gründern geführt. Dies bedeutet konkret, dass unsere Ziele nicht von externen Stakeholder:innen getrieben werden, sondern stets die Mitarbeitenden und unsere Kunden im Vordergrund stehen. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Kunden mit allen nötigen Skills auszustatten, damit diese vollumfänglich hinter ihrer Reise in die Cloud stehen und nach dem erfolgreichen Abschluss der gemeinsamen Projekte diese Veränderung eigenständig und nachhaltig leben. Man könnte fast sagen: „wir kommen, um zu gehen“. Milestones Mehr als 12.000 Slalomer:innen. Acht Länder. 45 Standorte. Und stetiges, schnelles Wachstum. In Deutschland haben wir unseren ersten Standort 2022 in München eröffnet, Düsseldorf und Frankfurt folgten in den Jahren 2023 und 2024. Das Team ist auf über 170 Mitarbeiter:innen angewachsen und wird sich auch in den nächsten Jahren stetig vergrößern. Wenn du dich angesprochen fühlst, freuen wir uns von dir zu hören!
