newJobs.descriptionText: Who You’ll Work With At Slalom, we co-create custom software, data and cloud products with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We're passionate about technology, compelled by its potential as we help create the digital products, experiences, and technology-driven organizations that drive true change. We’re thrilled by the opportunity to build the future we want to see, with anyone willing to join us. Slalom Cloud-Build’s Quality Engineering (QE) discipline brings a modern approach to software quality, playing a critical role in high-velocity software engineering teams. We work with current and emerging tools and techniques to help build reliable, scalable software. Our expertise in software quality principles and techniques enables key principles of whole-team ownership of quality, close proximity of software development and test activities, and reliable, scalable test automation. Our capability is comprised of passionate, flexible technologists who love to practice and hone their craft. As tools evolve and technologies emerge, we work to stay in front of innovation in automated software development and delivery. We work in cross-functional teams to build full-stack solutions across a range of established and emerging technologies and techniques, including: Front end applications targeting native mobile and modern web platforms. Examples include React, Native iOS/Android, and Vue. APIs and back-end services built using emerging frameworks and architectural patterns. Examples include microservices, Node, Typescript, Java and .Net. Hosting and application services provided by industry leading cloud providers. Examples include AWS, Azure and GCP. Data Engineering applications for real-time data solutions, data platforms, visualization, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Operational efficiencies leveraging modern ecosystems and automated build and deployment pipelines. Collaborative build practices that allow our teams to be agile and responsive to our clients’ needs. We are looking for candidates who are interested in working in a hybrid environment as we build the foundation and grow our team in Medellin and Bogota. We offer a flexible working environment to balance the need to work independently, with days that may require in-person collaboration at our office. What You’ll Do As a Senior Engineer, you will bring your expertise in software quality techniques and tools to a collaborative, team based environment. You will dive into the technical details, collaborating to design an optimal testing approach. You will work across multiple tech stacks and implement automation using a variety of tools. As a champion of quality, you will enable the team to maintain and improve velocity. Your growing experience and learning mindset enable you to take on a variety of new challenges and establish areas of expertise. You will have opportunities to share your knowledge and help us continually elevate the Quality Engineering discipline. Specifically, you will: Develop and evolve test plans for complex applications Deconstruct solutions into tests that optimize for coverage and risk Create trusted test automation with high reliability and relevancy Extend test automation frameworks to incorporate new functionality Assess and advise on testability of user stories, including acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and the definition of done. Share what you learn with your teams and the other members of the QE community What You’ll Bring As a Senior Engineer in the Quality Engineering discipline, you are experienced with working in an Agile team-based environment, and you consistently add velocity to the team. You confidently use code to build reliable, trusted test automation. You help define clear acceptance criteria, facilitate defect triage, and produce quality metrics. You possess an inquisitive, exploratory mindset, combined with strong test planning, communication, and organizational skills. You may have built deep expertise in a particular area of modern software quality, or you may have a breadth of experience across technology solutions. Your learning mindset enables you to take on new challenges to expand and deepen your skills across a wide variety of technology stacks. A computer science-based mindset is needed; a technology-based education is helpful. About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

newJobs.descriptionText: About TailorCare TailorCare is transforming the experience of specialty care. Our comprehensive care program takes a profoundly personal, evidence-based approach to improving patient outcomes for joint, back, and muscle conditions. By carefully assessing patients' symptoms, health histories, preferences, and goals with predictive data and the latest evidence-based guidelines, we help patients choose and navigate the most effective treatment pathway for them every step of the way. newJobs.descriptionText: It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world. About the Team Identity platforms at Yahoo provide modern, secure identity offerings for consumers and businesses interacting with Yahoo systems. These platforms operate at massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of users every day, and power critical authentication, authorization, and account management capabilities across Yahoo products. As part of Yahoo’s transition to an AI-First engineering model, teams increasingly leverage AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) combined with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Software Dev Engineer II to join our Identity organization. You will work across the stack to build secure, scalable, and user-friendly authentication and account management experiences that serve hundreds of millions of users globally. In this role, you will work independently with minimal guidance, owning critical features and acting as a technical resource for your peers. A core expectation is the ability to collaborate effectively with AI systems—using structured specs, deep codebase context, and prompt modeling to guide high-quality software implementation. We seek engineers who possess an experimentation-forward mindset and view AI as a force multiplier for architectural excellence and team-wide productivity. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate secure, scalable full-stack identity systems using ReactJS, TypeScript, Java, and Node.js. Own complex features and standalone project phases end-to-end, from gathering requirements and systems design to implementation, testing, and production. Lead an AI-first development workflow within the squad, writing precise markdown specifications to drive AI-assisted code generation (Cursor, Claude Code), and taking responsibility for the rigorous validation, testing, and safety of all generated assets. Identify system bottlenecks, enhance platform reliability, and debug complex production issues in our high-traffic distributed identity systems. Proactively research and implement AI-driven efficiencies in your daily coding workflows, replacing repetitive manual tasks with structured automation, custom templates, and AI-assisted testing. Act as a technical resource for the team by sharing successful prompt engineering patterns, context modeling strategies, and workflow optimizations that level up the overall engineering velocity of the squad. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, UX Designers, Security Engineers, and other Yahoo product squads to coordinate technical integrations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–6 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience. Strong hands-on engineering experience using Java for robust backend services. Experience building responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Next.js. Strong core engineering fundamentals in distributed system design, API development, databases, and web security. Demonstrated experience integrating AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into day-to-day software development workflows to build and refactor production-grade systems. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, model limitations, and structured context assembly to generate robust code outputs. Proven capability to evaluate, audit, and debug AI-generated outputs, ensuring alignment with Yahoo’s high standards for code quality, security protocols, and performance. Experience with testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing production-ready, highly maintainable tests. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or maintaining high-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems, auth protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), or web security standards. Cloud platform experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with observability tools (Splunk, Grafana) and client/server performance profiling. Experience with structured development methodologies, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD), API-first design, or AI-assisted diagnostic tools. Exposure to web accessibility (WCAG), internationalization, or large-scale consumer product delivery. What Success Looks Like Consistently deliver high-quality, high-impact features independently, ensuring secure user authentication experiences for hundreds of millions of users. Masterfully leverage AI-assisted tools to significantly compress development lifecycles while maintaining an ultra-high bar for security compliance and test coverage. Raise overall engineering standards by contributing to system architecture discussions, documenting clear technical specifications, and mentoring junior engineers. Accelerate squad velocity by sharing innovative, repeatable ways to integrate AI workflows into daily development, testing, and troubleshooting activities. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.descriptionText: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Managed Credentials solves one of the most important problems our enterprise customers face: governing the full lifecycle of company-controlled credentials. The team is building this natively into 1Password's Enterprise Password Manager, giving security and compliance teams the discovery, governance, and remediation capabilities they require, with full auditability and access control. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to guide this high-visibility product through launch and into maturity, delivering the governance capabilities that drive enterprise adoption and retention, while also supporting the team's ongoing work on our Managed Service Provider (MSP) offering. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. LEAD REVENUE RETENTION & EXPANSION - Achieve strong amendment and renewal upsell win rates; proactively source and advance expansion opportunities with documented context. - Maintain forecasting hygiene with minimal blank or unmodified renewals approaching subscription end. MONTH 6 – STRATEGIC IMPACT - Operating at full commercial autonomy; contributing to team practices and mentoring peers. - By Month 6, you are achieving top-tier customer satisfaction and recognized as a reliable commercial collaborator by your AE and cross-functional partners. Principal Applied Research Scientist – Generative AI and NLP
newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us The Mail Intelligence team is the brain behind the inbox. We are responsible for building the next generation of platforms and services that enable Yahoo to deliver deeply personalized, intelligent, and context-aware experiences to hundreds of millions of users globally. We process billions of messages and manage data on a petabyte scale. Using cutting-edge AI algorithms and foundation models, we extract knowledge and interconnect information from diverse sources to simplify our users' lives. Building this knowledge provides many challenges in the areas of natural language processing, machine learning techniques, and petabyte-scale data processing. You will build tools and workflows to make it easier to manage and act on this vast information, applying your insights to build innovative consumer applications for Yahoo Mail. A Lot About You You are a seasoned Applied ML Researcher who thrives at the intersection of theoretical innovation and production-grade execution. You don't just follow the latest LLM trends; you understand the mechanics of transformer architectures and how to optimize them for massive scale. You have expertise working across multiple ML and NLP spaces—including summarization, information extraction, classification, and ranking—at a very large scale. You have hands-on experience with knowledge distillation and believe that a model is only as good as its evaluation framework and low-latency production performance. You combine strong research fundamentals with pragmatic production instincts, comfortably navigating ambiguity to drive high-impact initiatives independently while mentoring and elevating engineering peers. Responsibilities Lead R&D: Drive the research strategy and development of deep learning and generative AI models specifically tailored for large-scale email and communication data. Model Innovation & Optimization: Define and advance approaches for fine-tuning and adapting open-source foundation models using parameter-efficient techniques (LoRA, adapters) and quantization-aware training. Efficiency at Scale: Design and implement knowledge distillation to transfer complex capabilities into smaller, high-performance models operating under strict latency budgets. Modern Evaluation Strategy: Establish and standardize robust evaluation frameworks, including LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, synthetic evaluation datasets, and human-in-the-loop validation. Product Integration: Build repeatable, scalable training and evaluation workflows for high-throughput production environments. AI-Augmented Development Workflow: Integrate AI pair-programming tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) and automated LLM workflows to accelerate experimental iteration, code generation, and research prototyping. Strategic Future-Proofing: Set technical direction for agent-based systems, tool-use paradigms, and long-term generative AI roadmaps. Technical Mentorship & Governance: Raise the bar for technical excellence by guiding researchers, shaping org-wide AI technical strategy, and establishing best practices for model validation. Qualifications PhD (preferred) or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field. 9+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning and deep learning, with significant hands-on work in NLP and generative models at scale. Demonstrated experience fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA or other parameter-efficient methods. Experience with knowledge distillation, model compression, and/or training smaller models from larger teacher models. Hands-on experience using LLMs for pseudo-labeling and synthetic data generation to create high-quality training datasets. Experience building and evaluating LLM-based agents, including tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and reasoning workflows. Deep understanding of transformer architectures (encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder) and modern generative transformer techniques. Experience designing evaluation frameworks for generative systems, including prompt-based evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge approaches, and automated output validation. Hands-on experience incorporating AI pair-programming tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) or LLM workbench environments into daily developer and research workflows. Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, along with Hugging Face tooling. Experience building scalable data pipelines and training workflows for large datasets. Strong experimental rigor and ability to translate research ideas into production-ready systems. Excellent communication skills and ability to operate effectively in cross-functional, fast-moving environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with large-scale distributed training and inference. Experience building, deploying, and optimizing models for on-device or resource-constrained environments (quantization, pruning, distillation). Experience with agent frameworks, tool use, or multi-step reasoning systems. Familiarity with prompt engineering, preference optimization (RLHF/DPO), or model alignment techniques. Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in NLP or generative AI. Experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and large-scale experimentation infrastructure. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Proven experience launching and scaling consumer-grade applications (mobile and/or web). Strong understanding of patient journeys, engagement mechanics, and behavior change. Experience working closely with designers on UX, usability, and accessibility. Data-driven mindset with ability to define metrics, run experiments, and interpret insights. Comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces and turning loose concepts into shipped products. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor’s degree required; clinical or health-related background is a plus. What's In It For You Meaningful Work: We are dedicated to our mission and deeply value our patients and each other. newJobs.descriptionText: About McKesson Compile Established in 1833, McKesson is a US Fortune 10 global leader in healthcare supply chain management solutions, retail pharmacy, healthcare technology, community oncology, and specialty care. We partner with life sciences companies, manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, governments, and other healthcare organizations to help provide the right medicines, medical products, and healthcare services to the right patients at the right time, safely and cost effectively. Based in Bangalore India, McKesson Compile’s data is a comprehensive, full linked system of record for the US Healthcare market, with intelligence on 2M+ healthcare professionals (HCPs) and over 800K facilities. Compile’s data includes high capture medical and pharmacy claims, closed capture Medicare claims (100%), along with best-in-class provider affiliations and customer master. At McKesson we deliver careers with purpose and potential. Our focus on better health starts with creating an inclusive environment with strong values where you can build a fulfilling career. You can count on us to provide you with resources and opportunities to grow and be your best, while contributing to our pursuit of improving lives. The Sr. Associate QA Automation Engineer is responsible for developing and executing manual and automated testing activities across Ontada's product ecosystem, including AI-enabled and GenAI-powered solutions. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and QA leads, the engineer will contribute to validating web applications, APIs, backend services, data workflows, and AI-driven features to ensure high levels of product quality, reliability, and performance. This role partners closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Operations teams to support the delivery of secure, scalable, and customer-focused healthcare technology solutions. Key Responsibilities Quality Engineering Ownership & Execution Execute test plans and test cases for assigned features and product modules. Participate in requirement reviews and contribute to test scenario identification. Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence. Perform functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing. Support release validation activities across multiple environments. Test Automation & Framework Development Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and service-layer testing. Contribute to existing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, TOSCA, or equivalent technologies. Develop and execute API automation tests using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar frameworks. Support integration of automation suites into CI/CD pipelines. Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar tools to improve productivity and test coverage. AI / GenAI Quality Engineering Assist in validating AI-enabled and GenAI-powered product features. Participate in testing prompt-based workflows and AI-generated responses. Support validation activities focused on response accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Execute predefined test scenarios covering prompt variations and edge cases. Develop familiarity with concepts such as LLMs, prompts, RAG, AI agents, and guardrails. Utilize AI-powered tools to assist with test scenario generation and exploratory testing. Backend & Data Testing Perform backend testing using SQL and/or NoSQL data systems. Validate data ingestion, transformations, persistence, and integrity across services and environments. Assist with testing asynchronous workflows and integrations (e.g., message queues, APIs, batch processes). Agile Collaboration Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives. Support shift-left testing practices by engaging early in feature development. Quality Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement Contribute audit‑ready documentation, including test plans, execution evidence, and reports. Participate in root‑cause discussions for quality issues and contribute to corrective actions. Identify opportunities for improving QA processes, tools, and documentation; contribute suggestions through established continuous improvement channels. Research and evaluate new QA, automation, or performance testing, AI assisted tools and techniques as appropriate. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 2+ years of relevant experience. Education Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. Critical Skills 2+ years of Software Quality Assurance experience. 2+ years of hands-on test automation experience. Experience with at least one automation framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or TOSCA. Experience with API testing using Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent tools. Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript. Experience working in Agile development environments. Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. Experience with SQL for backend validation and data testing. Familiarity with Git-based source control systems. Additional Skills: Exposure to AI/GenAI testing concepts. Experience testing LLM-powered or AI-enabled applications. Understanding of prompt engineering and prompt validation. Familiarity with RAG architectures and AI evaluation techniques. Knowledge of healthcare technology or regulated environments. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Working Conditions Full-time in office role based in Bangalore, India (IST). Collaboration with distributed, cross‑functional teams. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind: McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application. McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates. McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com.

newJobs.descriptionText: Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. At Huron, you have the opportunity to discover your professional passions by being an integral part of our teams and getting exposure to a variety of projects. Our Analysts join us from a wide range of backgrounds and have immediate access to the training and coaching they need to drive impact and develop into the innovators and leaders of tomorrow. We provide the opportunity to enhance analytical skills while working as part of a team committed to developing creative insights, implementing processes, and driving tangible results. Our Analysts work independently and in group settings to get hands on experience in building effective relationships and creating solutions for our clients. Health systems, academic medical centers, and other healthcare provider organizations are all trying to address a common enterprise problem: our data should be telling us more than it is, so what is in the way, and how can we develop a data-driven, AI-enabled approach to our mission? Our Assessments team answers that question. We go into an organization, map how data moves and where it stalls, quantify what the friction costs, and hand leadership a case for change they can act on and fund. As a Senior Analyst you sit at the center of that work. You will support current-state analysis, build the value stream maps that make bottlenecks visible, size the gap between where a client is and where they need to be, and translate client needs into strategy roadmaps an executive committee can approve. You will work within a broader assessment team to develop future state vision statements and develop executable roadmaps Role Responsibilities Include Analyzing data, synthesizing documentation, developing value stream maps, drafting future state process designs. Synthesizing client stakeholder interviews, identifying process improvement opportunities Developing recommendations, building business cases, defining return on investment (ROI) for proposed data management modernization initiatives. Developing executive summaries in PowerPoint & Word Analyzing client documentation in Excel Development of reports, dashboards, and visualizations as needed in Power BI ­ Qualifications 1+ years of work experience in consulting, healthcare, or financial analysis 1+ years of experience using BI & Visualization tools such as Oracle Analytics Cloud, Tableau or Power BI 1+ years of experience with SQL programming. 1+ years of experience working with data sources such as Databases, Data Lakes or Cloud Applications. Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science/Management or Information Systems or equivalent Additional Preferred Skill Requirements: Familiarity with Enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake. Data Engineering experience a major plus. Has strong presentation and collaborative skills and can communicate all aspects of the job requirements, including the creation of formal documentation /deliverables Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent organizational, time-management, and communication skills Experience with project management and/or software implementation process Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong interpersonal skills in working with clients and co-workers Strong client management skills Willingness to travel up to 50% (project dependent) The estimated base salary for this job is $85,000 - $95,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $93,500 - $104,500. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future. newJobs.descriptionText: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. As part of the SaaS Manager https://1password.com/product/saas-manager team, you'll be building the platform that IT and Security teams rely on to discover, govern, and optimize their AI and SaaS ecosystems (work that just earned 1Password recognition as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SaaS Management Platforms). You'll work on real problems: uncontrolled AI spend, shadow IT, SaaS sprawl, and the complex access lifecycles that come with it. Following 1Password's acquisition of Trelica in early 2025 https://blog.1password.com/1password-acquires-trelica/, you'll join a collaborative team with a startup mindset backed by the resources and mission of one of the most trusted names in security. As we scale the platform to meet our enterprise-scale ambitions, you'll help shape not just what we build, but how we build it. We are hiring a Senior Developer who can go deep on complex problems and come up for air to bring their team with them; someone who ships high-quality work with a high degree of independence, champions technical excellence within their team, and makes the engineers around them better in the process. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US, ideally with the ability to work within Eastern Time hours. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: - You have 5+ years of experience in software development, with strong working knowledge of .NET/C#/MongoDB or similar. - You can tackle large, complex engineering problems with a high degree of independence. - You're a subject matter expert in the features and systems your team owns; you identify gaps, propose improvements, and leave code meaningfully better than you found it. - You champion technical innovation within your team: you evaluate new tools and approaches critically, advocate for the ones worth adopting, and help your teammates understand why. - You set a high bar for code quality through thorough code reviews, strong test coverage, and clear documentation. You share your reasoning in a way that helps others grow. - You communicate well across technical and non-technical contexts: you can write a clear design doc, facilitate a productive engineering discussion, and explain a hard problem to a partner without losing the plot. - You have a practical, curious approach to agentic AI in the software development lifecycle: you use it where it creates real leverage in your own work, form opinions about what's actually useful, and share what you learn with your team without needing to be prompted - You're a strong mentor: you guide less experienced developers through pair programming, code review feedback, and technical conversations, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and independence over time WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT: - Own the design and delivery of complex features end-to-end, from initial scoping through production, with minimal guidance and a high standard for what "done" means - Contribute to and lead technical design discussions within your team: write clear design documents, surface risks early, propose solutions, and build consensus around the right approach - Set and uphold best practices within the team (e.g. testing strategies, code quality norms, observability standards, etc.) and make sure they stick through code reviews and hands-on involvement. - Partner closely with product managers and designers to understand the customer problems behind the work, advocate for sound engineering, and help the team make good tradeoffs - Bring a practical, hands-on perspective on where agentic AI tools create genuine leverage in your own workflow and share what works with your teammates BONUS POINTS FOR: - Experience evolving a legacy or growth-stage application into an enterprise-scale platform - Comfort across a wide range of technical stacks (.NET/C#, MongoDB, Go, Rust, TypeScript, React, and others); you evaluate technology on its merits for the problem at hand, not personal preference, and you pick up new languages quickly USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $153,000 USD and $214,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $144,000 CAD and $202,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. Our approach to remote work We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo is made up of several organizations, each led by a GM and focused on driving key product lines. This role sits within the Yahoo Mail group, home to our flagship product, Yahoo Mail. You’ll be joining a team — that has a great product line, with its 4.5+ star app experiences, strong business foundation, and robust technology, is well-positioned in the consumer communication space. Now, we’re entering our next chapter: building the most consumer-focused platform for managing the “business of life,” through email and beyond. You’ll join a team of engineers dedicated to delivering the best consumer mail experience, meticulously refining every detail to make that vision a reality. A Lot About You You’re an experienced engineering leader who loves building and empowering teams to create and maintain products that delight millions of users. You’re passionate about high-quality application development, technology stack, and the cloud - and you take pride in seeing your teams deliver great consumer experiences at scale. You know how to balance big-picture vision with hands-on leadership - guiding teams to think deeply about users, scenarios, and edge cases, while driving projects to successful completion. You lead with empathy and curiosity, create a culture of growth and collaboration, and understand the broader impact of great engineering on both people and the business. If you’re excited to join a world-class team of passionate engineers and industry veterans who care about code quality, design, and user experience as much as they enjoy working together - we’d love to talk to you. Responsibilities: Build, lead, and scale high-performing full-stack engineering teams that deliver world-class consumer products and experiences used by millions of customers globally. Define and execute the engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning technical investments with product priorities, business objectives, and long-term platform evolution. Drive AI-native software development practices across the organization, leveraging AI-powered tools, agents, automation, and modern engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and speed of execution. Lead AI transformation initiatives that reimagine how products are built, operated, and experienced, creating measurable value for users, developers, and the business. Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and business leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver innovative AI-powered customer experiences that differentiate Yahoo Mail in the market. Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, experimentation, and continuous learning while attracting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and AI advancements, guiding architectural decisions, technical reviews, and strategic investments that enable scalable and responsible innovation. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience building and delivering large-scale consumer software products, with at least 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams and engineering managers. Proven success leading engineering organizations that consistently deliver high-quality products while balancing innovation, execution, operational excellence, and business outcomes. Experience leading AI-native product organizations or large-scale AI transformation programs within consumer technology companies. Demonstrated experience operating in an AI-native development environment and leveraging modern AI technologies, copilots, agents, and automation to transform engineering workflows. Proven track record leading AI transformation initiatives that have delivered measurable improvements in developer productivity, customer experience, operational efficiency, or business performance. Strong technical expertise in modern application development, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, mobile and web platforms, and scalable software design. Hands-on experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, or similar technologies, with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and architectural decisions. Experience integrating Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning capabilities, or intelligent agent systems into products, platforms, or engineering processes. Strong business acumen with the ability to identify and prioritize opportunities where AI can create competitive advantage, accelerate growth, improve customer engagement, and unlock operational efficiencies. Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across functions, drive organizational change, and build high-performing, inclusive teams in fast-paced environments. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building, scaling, or modernizing email, messaging, communications, or productivity platforms serving millions of users. Recognized thought leadership in AI strategy, engineering productivity, platform modernization, or organizational transformation. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Must be able to work off shifts Stretch the organization by creating a learning culture, problem solving, envisioning the future state condition, and leading towards fulfillment. Responsible for the planning, development and successful implementation of capital equipment/tooling improvement plans including new product launch activities. Facilitation of formal continuous improvement kaizen activities when required in the endless pursuit of waste elimination throughout the Akron facility. Drives new product development for the site including APQP deliverables, tooling and equipment concepts, quotations, process development, qualification and approval processes Improve manufacturing processes and methods for cost-reduction, quality improvement and efficiency using lean manufacturing. Experience in managing and leading large projects within a manufacturing facility Proven track record in the Coaching & Development of subordinates. Working knowledge of Fabrication & Weld/Fit processes, metal forming processes and associated equipment. Ability to own and manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks in order to meet deadlines; Certified project management skills preferred. Strong computer skills with proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and working knowledge of 3D modeling software, such as Auto-Cad. Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us! newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results. A Little About Us Yahoo is a global media and tech company that connects people to their interests. We reach nearly 900 million people around the world, bringing them closer to what they love—from finance and sports, to shopping, gaming, and news—through trusted products, content, and technology that fuel their day. For partners, we provide a full-stack platform that helps businesses amplify growth and build meaningful connections across advertising, search, and media. Within Yahoo Games, our mission is to make games a natural extension of the daily Yahoo experience—easy to discover, fun to play, and rewarding to return to. We are building a modern casual games platform that combines high-quality content, strong platform capabilities, and the power of the Yahoo ecosystem to drive engagement at scale. A Lot About You We are seeking a creative, analytical, and results-driven Senior Product Manager (Games) to help define and scale the Yahoo Games portfolio. This role is primarily responsible for driving the growth, engagement, and evolution of our games portfolio, ensuring we deliver a steady pipeline of high-quality experiences that players return to daily. You will lead the development of both first-party and third-party games, owning the strategy and execution required to build a compelling, sustainable portfolio. This includes shaping new game concepts, partnering with internal and external developers, and continuously optimizing performance through data, experimentation, and player insight. You will also play a key role in driving user experience research (UXR)—developing a deep understanding of player behavior, motivations, and market trends, and translating those insights into product decisions that improve engagement, retention, and overall player experience. In addition to games, you will collaborate with our discovery and platform teams to ensure strong alignment to improve how users find and engage with games and platform features that reinforce retention and repeat play. You are equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing day-to-day. You bring a strong understanding of game systems, player behavior, and live operations, and you use data, UXR, and experimentation to drive outcomes. You are also excited about leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product development, enhance workflows, and unlock new opportunities across gameplay, personalization, and content creation. Your Day at Yahoo Define and evolve the product strategy and roadmap for the Yahoo Games portfolio, aligned with broader company goals. Lead the development and launch of first-party games, third-party integrations, and supporting platform features. Partner with Game Design, Engineering, Product Design, Analytics, and Production to deliver high-quality, engaging game experiences. Drive user experience research (UXR) efforts, leveraging player data, playtests, and market insights to inform product decisions. Continuously analyze game performance and player behavior to optimize engagement, retention, and monetization. Architect AI-augmented dashboards and reporting structures to track KPIs and generate actionable insights. Define and prioritize product requirements, balancing user impact, business goals, and technical constraints. Lead Agile development processes, ensuring consistent delivery and iteration toward long-term goals. Collaborate with external partners and developers to source, evaluate, and integrate third-party content. Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies and tools to enhance the product development lifecycle, experimentation, reporting and team productivity. Stay current on trends in gaming, AI, and consumer product development to inform strategy and innovation. You Must Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with a focus on consumer-facing products. Experience building or managing casual games on web or mobile platforms. Proven track record of leading products from concept to launch and iteration. Deep understanding of game systems, player behavior, and engagement/retention mechanics. Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and analytics teams. Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform decisions and prioritize work. Experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and performance optimization. Experience managing external partners or third-party integrations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience using AI tools (e.g., for analysis, prototyping, content generation, or development workflows) and a willingness to incorporate AI into product thinking and execution. Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, iterative environment. Strong judgment in evaluating AI-generated outputs and validating data integrity to ensure high-quality product decision-making. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

solutions in the market, translating portfolio strategy into compelling client and partner narratives Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure portfolio strategies align with evolving North American regulatory, legislative, privacy, and security requirements Proactively identify and manage portfolio-level risks—scalability challenges, data integrity, support models, and delivery risks Monitor and communicate portfolio health metrics, including platform stability, modernization progress, and delivery risk A typical week You'll likely spend time in stakeholder alignment meetings (working across distributed product, technology, and delivery teams), digging into business cases for major modernization investments, collaborating with your Architecture partner on target-state platform direction, and communicating trade-offs and priorities to senior leadership. You'll also work hands-on with product managers to review emerging roadmap items and with partners to understand market pressures and opportunities. What you bring Must-haves 10+ years in Product Management, Product Portfolio Management, or Platform Leadership roles, ideally in enterprise, complex environments Deep expertise in Group Benefits Administration, with particular strength and knowledge of the U.S. market, legislation, and compliance landscape Proven track record leading multi-product portfolios with the ability to think and operate at enterprise scale Experience overseeing modernization and large-scale migration programs, including managing legacy platforms, multi-tenant complexity, and change at scale Strong executive-level communication skills and proven ability to influence across matrixed organizations with distributed ownership models Sound judgment in prioritization and trade-off decisions—you're comfortable making tough calls and explaining the "why" to senior stakeholders Working knowledge of North American regulatory and compliance environments, with demonstrated expertise in U.S. Group Benefits market requirements Nice-to-haves Experience supporting channel and carrier partnerships (partner enablement, alignment of capabilities to market opportunities) Background working closely with Architecture or Technology leadership on platform strategy Experience defining governance models and operating frameworks across product portfolios Familiarity with employer, carrier, and partner ecosystems across both public and private sector markets Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. Ready to lead portfolio strategy at enterprise scale? If you're energized by complexity, thrive in stakeholder-driven environments, and want to shape the future of benefits administration across North America, let's talk. This team builds the high-performance integration layer that embeds Xometry’s AI-native marketplace directly into the world’s leading CAD and PLM platforms. You will be the primary technical architect for our landmark partnership with a major enterprise partner. This is not a standard plug-in project; you will be responsible for extracting Xometry’s core AI engines (DFM and IQE) and natively embedding them into our partner's core digital ecosystems. Your work will enable a "science fiction speed" workflow where designers receive real-time manufacturability and pricing feedback on native 3D geometry without ever leaving their primary design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. How You'll Contribute: Software Development and Technical Craft: You will lead the discovery, architectural design, and adoption of our flagship embedded partner integration. You'll introduce best practices for handling native 3D geometry data flows and ensure our systems are extensible, scalable, and capable of delivering real-time AI insights at the moment of design. AI Fluency: You will leverage AI tools to accelerate the development of geometry-processing pipelines and collaborate with our Data Science team to ensure the "IQE" (Instant Quoting) engine performs with sub-second latency within the partner application UI. In addition, you’ll define and evangelize the organization's AI fluency standards, coaching Staff and Senior engineers on integrating AI tooling into architecture, design, and development workflows to drive measurable productivity and quality outcomes. Problem Solving and Decision Making: You will tackle complex issues involving deep technical coupling between Xometry’s marketplace and our partner's enterprise software environment. You'll exercise judgment in selecting the right methods for ring-fenced data governance and "one-click" order placement within enterprise-grade security constraints. Scope and Impact: You are responsible for leading cross-team decision-making and executing multi-quarter roadmaps. Your work directly impacts Xometry’s strategic edge, moving us from lightweight HTML snippets to a deep, native integration that eliminates the need for design file exports. Collaboration and Communication: You will act as the primary technical point of contact for our partner's engineering teams. You'll motivate internal Xometry teams to embrace the vision of a "unified digital thread" and mentor senior and mid-level engineers through complex design reviews. Operational Excellence: You will own the reliability and security of the integration microservices, ensuring that "click-to-buy" functionality is bulletproof and that monitoring/alerting covers the unique lifecycle of enterprise PLM transactions. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. About the Role We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms for Yahoo Mail, to lead the product strategy and execution for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared technology integrations. This role owns the horizontal capabilities that power Yahoo Mail experiences across all platforms, including authentication, identity, privacy, security, and foundational client frameworks. This is a senior, highly cross-functional role that works deeply with application engineering teams, experience-focused product managers, and central platform and infrastructure teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that Yahoo Mail clients remain secure, compliant, scalable, and adaptable as the product ecosystem evolves. A critical dimension of this role is guiding Yahoo Mail through large-scale platform transitions and service realignments, ensuring continuity for users and partners while enabling independent execution across multiple organizations. This work requires strong systems thinking, excellent stakeholder management, and comfort operating in complex commercial and technical environments. What You’ll Do Own the product vision and roadmap for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared services across web, iOS, Android, and emerging surfaces. Define and shape the strategic roadmaps for Yahoo Mail client platforms, including decisions around codebases, architectural patterns, and technology investments that enable long-term scalability and maintainability. Partner closely with application engineering teams to ensure client platforms are built and operated in a cost-efficient manner, balancing performance, developer velocity, and operational complexity. Drive adoption of modern technologies and platform capabilities to deliver fast, reliable, and secure user experiences across all clients. Partner with AI and platform teams to enable client-side support for AI-powered experiences, ensuring Yahoo Mail clients can securely and efficiently integrate capabilities such as intelligent assistance, personalization, and emerging AI-driven features. Lead cross-platform initiatives spanning authentication, identity, privacy, security, and compliance, in close collaboration with central platform teams. Act as the connective tissue between client engineering, experience-focused product managers, and backend platform teams, ensuring cohesive end-to-end execution. Drive platform consistency while enabling differentiated experiences across clients where appropriate. Lead complex platform transitions, service separations, and long-running partner support programs that require coordination across multiple teams, organizations, and external stakeholders. Ensure client platforms are resilient to organizational change, capable of operating independently where required, and aligned with long-term commercial, legal, and regulatory constraints. Represent Yahoo Mail in executive-level discussions related to platform strategy, technical risk, timelines, and tradeoffs. Define and track success metrics across performance, security posture, reliability, cost efficiency, and developer productivity, using data to guide prioritization and investment decisions. What We’re Looking For Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of platforms, infrastructure-adjacent products, or large-scale client systems. Experience building and operating consumer applications at scale is strongly preferred. Direct experience with email platforms or messaging systems is a strong plus, given the unique technical, operational, and trust challenges of email. Application Platform Leadership: Proven ability to define and evolve shared capabilities used by many teams, balancing consistency with flexibility while keeping end users and business customers connected through reliable, scalable platforms. Technical Depth: Strong technical fluency across client architectures, authentication and identity systems, privacy and security controls, and platform integrations. Familiarity with the complexity and constraints of email ecosystems (deliverability, trust, abuse prevention, identity, and standards) is highly valued. Complex Program Ownership: Demonstrated success leading ambiguous, multi-year initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, external dependencies, and contractual considerations, while maintaining operational stability and user trust. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to align engineering, legal, privacy, security, commercial, and executive stakeholders around a common plan, particularly in environments where platforms serve both consumers and enterprise partners. Product Judgment: Strong instincts for risk management, sequencing, and tradeoffs in high-impact, high-visibility environments, with a focus on protecting user trust and long-term platform health. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical, organizational, and platform concepts to senior audiences. Mission & Product Mindset: A genuine interest in building products that empower people in their day-to-day lives, with an appreciation for email as a vital, enduring communications tool that continues to have real-world impact at a global scale Your Day-to-Day Partner with client and platform engineering leaders to translate strategic goals into executable roadmaps. Collaborate with experienced product managers to ensure platform capabilities enable high-quality user experiences across all clients. Work closely with identity, authentication, privacy, and security teams to ensure compliant and secure implementations. Lead planning and execution for major platform changes, transitions, and long-term initiatives. Identify risks early, drive alignment on mitigation strategies, and keep senior leadership informed. Serve as a trusted product leader for some of the most complex and foundational work within Yahoo Mail. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Core Responsibilities: Environment Management: Build and configure shared and client-specific environments including production, non-production, and disaster recovery systems Server & Application Deployment: Perform server installations, configurations, deployments, and OS upgrades using Microsoft technologies (Windows Server 2012-2019, IIS) Database Administration: Execute SQL Server tasks including database backup/restore, user permissions management, and T-SQL script deployment Active Directory Management: Handle user and group creation, delegation, and domain environment administration System Migration & Upgrades: Lead server and application migrations, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance Automation & Scripting: Develop PowerShell scripts and system reports using SQL Report Builder to streamline operations and reduce manual work Issue Resolution: Triage, analyze, and coordinate resolution of complex technical issues across applications hosted on various platforms Client Support: Provide technical guidance and support to client IT teams, including after-hours support during critical releases and busy periods Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain technical documentation, service catalogs, and ensure security and performance standards What makes this work interesting: You’ll own the full environment stack not just databases, not just servers, but the complete deployment pipeline. You’ll work on client migrations and modernization projects, troubleshoot complex multi-tier issues, and have immediate impact on mission-critical systems. You’ll also collaborate with client IT teams on strategic decisions about their infrastructure – this isn’t just “keep the lights on,” it’s helping clients succeed. What you bring Must-Have Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering (or equivalent experience) with 3–5+ years of relevant infrastructure and systems administration experience Windows Server Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Windows Server 2012-2019 (installation, configuration, management, and IIS role) — this is foundational to the work Database Expertise: Strong SQL Server management skills, including T-SQL and SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services); experience with backup/restore, user permissions, and script deployment Scripting & Automation: Advanced knowledge of PowerShell scripting; practical experience with VBScript, CMD, and SQL scripting — automation is central to this role Active Directory Management: Experience with Active Directory or LDAP in domain environments Application Architecture Understanding: Knowledge of N-Tier applications utilizing IIS web frontend, .NET services, and SQL Server backend — you don't need to be a developer, but you need to understand how these layers work together Microsoft Azure Experience: Working experience with Microsoft Azure (Storage, ASG, VMs, Azure DB) — hands-on cloud platform skills Problem-Solving: Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to manage multiple assignments and think systematically Communication: Strong interpersonal skills with ability to explain complex technical solutions to diverse audiences (client IT teams, team members, stakeholders) — this team runs on knowledge sharing Nice-to-Have DevOps Tools: Knowledge of Octopus Deploy or Azure DevOps Pipeline Advanced Cloud: Experience with Azure Serverless, Azure Container Instance, Kubernetes, and Docker Multi-Cloud: Familiarity with AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Methodologies: Experience working with Agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban) .NET Development Familiarity: Practical experience or working knowledge of .NET development (VB.Net or C#) — this helps with application troubleshooting, but isn't required Salary Range: $49,000.00 - $89,700.00 CAD Annual Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. newJobs.descriptionText: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Facilities Maintenance Service Technician (Distribution Center) Location -Uxbridge, MA, USA - 40 Lackey Dam Compensation: The hourly pay range for this position is $30-35/hr (depending upon experience). The afternoon shift also comes with a $1/hr shift differential. 2 Shifts available: Monday to Friday, 1pm-9:30pm OR Monday to Friday, 8am-4:30pm Note: OT mandatory if required. Shift may change based on needs of the business. ***Walk in interviews -Week of Aug 10-14, Monday to Friday from 8am-2pm. Meet the supervisor(s), see the facility and have a face-to-face interview. No appointment needed! Bring a resume if you can. Ask for Eric Berlo. Address - Uxbridge, MA, USA - 40 Lackey Dam*** Facilities Representatives are eligible to participate in a company incentive plan and can earn up to an additional 5% of their salary, which would be paid out bi-weekly. This career opportunity comes with a comprehensive benefit program (health and wellness – dental/medical/prescription). Benefits are competitive to meet the needs of each location and may also include paid time off, stock purchase plan, retirement support (401K), education reimbursement, flexible work arrangements, maternity and caregiver leave. Job Summary: McKesson’s temperature controlled automated Distribution Center is currently hiring a Facility Maintenance Service Technician. This is a chance to work for a company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. This position involves ensuring the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the distribution center facility by monitoring building systems, conducting routine inspections, and coordinating maintenance activities. This individual will evaluate facility needs, recommend improvements to optimize space utilization, and support uninterrupted operations through proactive facility management and maintenance practices. What You'll Need The ideal candidate will have experience maintaining and repairing equipment in a distribution center, manufacturing, or industrial environment, along with strong troubleshooting skills, a commitment to safety, and the ability to work effectively with employees at all levels. Qualifications include: Facility maintenance, maintenance technician, or service technician experience. Experience troubleshooting, diagnosing, and repairing a variety of equipment used in a distribution center environment. Knowledge of and ability to safely operate maintenance-related tools and equipment, including hand tools, power tools, conveyors, forklifts, pressure gauges, voltmeters, and similar equipment. Basic knowledge of warehouse operations and distribution center environments. Exposure to multiple maintenance and skilled trades, including mechanical, electrical, and facility systems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with frontline employees, vendors, and leadership teams. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new equipment, technologies, and conveyance systems. Working knowledge of Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and OSHA safety standards. Physical Requirements: Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. Includes standing, sitting, walking, general labor, ladder, scissor lift & fork truck use, climbing up to (4) story heights in a warehouse environment. May work at heights at times Note - This posting is an overview of role and not reflective of all responsibilities/qualifications required for the position. About MMS McKesson Medical-Surgical (MMS), which is expected to become Wellverse in early 2027, is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital.
